language_samples.source: 散文《我们能承受多少真相》(As Much Truth as One Can Bear)，原文。中文大意：不是所有被直面的都能改变，但不被直面的什么也改变不了。
language_samples.text: Not everything that is faced can be changed, but nothing can be changed until it is faced.

language_samples.source: 《下一次将是烈火》(The Fire Next Time)，原文。
language_samples.text: Love takes off the masks that we fear we cannot live without and know we cannot live within.
